name: List Stripe Payment Intents
description: Lists Stripe payment intents with filtering by customer and date range. Compresses responses by removing internal fields (client_secret, payment_method_options, shipping, etc.).

createdAfter.description: Filter payment intents created after this Unix timestamp

createdBefore.description: Filter payment intents created before this Unix timestamp

limit.description: Number of payment intents to return (1-100)

startingAfter.description: Cursor for pagination (payment intent ID to start after)

steps.name: Strip verbose internal fields from each payment intent
